name: aae
description: MongoDB Atlas Agent Engine toolkit: the aae-guide specialist (a subagent in Claude Code, a skill in Codex) with its bundled, dated knowledge base, the atlas-cli specialist for the Atlas control-plane CLI, the aae-roadmap specialist for where the platform is going (every claim linked to its source and dated), docs-change detection (a git-sourced docs watcher, a session-start notice and an optional daily schedule that can also update the knowledge base), the aae-scout prior-art and freshness check, skills that add an agent to an existing monorepo, tear one down cleanly and migrate a workspace onto a differently-named Atlas cluster, and an 'ae' shortcut for the agentengine CLI.

interface.shortDescription: MongoDB Atlas Agent Engine toolkit, with docs-change detection
